additional_info.subject: RE: ID0367965-DC/Si-D/AE-[MP / R5 170001909] Out of order (MOEI-UAE) CRM:00797001097
additional_info.body:
Hello Basheer Thangal
Since your issue has been resolved, we will be proceeding with closing the service ticket# 0367965.
If you need any further assistance, please do reach back out to us by sending a new email to
emobility_support.si@siemens.com
.
Troubleshooting steps performed during the site visit:
Initial Inspection
:
Checked the QA1 components for feasibility and visually verified that there were no issues.
Error Detection
:
After closing the door, within a couple of minutes, the charger went out of order, and the QA1 error flag was triggered on the SCB.
Wiring Check
:
Inspected all feedback wires of QA1, both 24VDC connections, and 0V connections on XD9.1A & XD9.1B.
Connector Inspection
:
Unplugged the XD9 connector located below KF10, rechecked the wires, reinserted the connector, and tightened the connections.
Reboot Request
:
Requested a charger reboot. The charger functioned correctly, which might have been due to some loose connections when closing the main door of the SiD.
Charger Status
:
The charger was healthy, and all outlets were ready to charge, but the OCPP was offline.
OCPP Configuration
:
Configured all settings on the OCPP router. The data connection was present, and the SIM was ready, but the OCPP connection remained offline.
OCPP URL Adjustment
:
Identified a gap at the end of the OCPP URL ID and OCPP charge point ID. Removed the gap, and the OCPP connection came online.
Kindly note that email responses to closed tickets are not monitored.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team - Shrey Sharma
Please do not change the subject of this Email when replying to it.
